findings.text: non-blocking: the fragment states the focused equilibrium and DIII-D comparison ran 'on all_debug', but focused-source/focused-base.log and focused-source/focused-head.log carry no partition header and were written from the worker's own allocation (job 1319168, partition sun), so done_when (3)'s named host is asserted rather than evidenced; the pass measure itself is CPU pytest and both arms are recorded.

non-blocking: _display_coupling's docstring still says its plasma columns are 'the same uniform hybrid_greens block the solve lattice consumes', which the node made false at :1285 where the solve keeps polygon block 0; a display map from the hybrid kernel is 0.04-0.07% away from the solve's own grid columns per the recorded difference receipt.

item_verdicts.call_sites: the change's only consumers checked were benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:1461 (_build_profile) reading couplings[5], [6] and [11], and benchmarks/forward_solve_memory_ledger.py:340 reading couplings[5] and [12]; both read shapes and byte counts that the diff leaves unchanged.
item_verdicts.diff: read all 15 commits against 3b05ffb6: e252f00a5 is the ten-line product change, 4ec23b915 the regression test, 613cd9ac2 and 0129893bf the gates and extraction fixture, 8d0f54acb and 1a9b64dbf the difference map, and f99051c59, 09cfdef95, e2836e90c, 9bbed5788, b52ea86fa, 56837fa21, d68bb5185 and 9ff3d99fd the paired arms, recovery and fragment, all inside the fence.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's clause (1) is asserted at tests/equilibrium/test_diiid_single_kernel_coupling.py:78-85 against the recorded build_flux_blocks return and reddens in tests/negative-control.log '3 failed, 1 passed' EXIT=1; clause (2) is recorded in docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-single-kernel-coupling.html with the coupling-difference contours and the eight terminal arms; clause (3) is recorded in focused-comparison.json as 96 passed at the base and 96 at the head with one identical failure per arm, although the all_debug host it names is not logged.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that every plasma coupling row of the DIII-D builder comes from one exact polygon-kernel evaluation; benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:1282-1287 attaches grid_moments[0], wall_moments[0] and sample_moments[0] from one _moment_couplings call, so the uniform, radial and vertical rows of the grid, wall and sampling targets each share one build_flux_blocks evaluation.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, 15 commits e252f00a5..9ff3d99fd, after_suite 4 passed EXIT=0 at b52ea86, negative_control_log tests/negative-control.log, test_logs naming the scoped gate and the focused arms, and a blockers line recording the completion audit's refusal of an empty scoped base.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the fence was benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py, tests/equilibrium/test_diiid_single_kernel_coupling.py, scripts/prototypes/diiid_single_kernel_coupling, docs/figures/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-single-kernel-coupling and docs/evidence/fragments/diiid-vertical-force-balance/diiid-single-kernel-coupling.html; git diff 3b05ffb6..9ff3d99 touches exactly those and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/equilibrium/test_diiid_single_kernel_coupling.py:81-85 fails when the hybrid uniform row is restored, shown by tests/negative-control.log naming grid-0, wall-1 and sample-2 at 3 failed; the coordinate assertion at :77 compares the operator target to the coordinate the builder itself passed to build_flux_blocks, so it holds for any coordinate the builder chooses.
justifications.evidence: final-scoped-test.log reads '4 passed' at b52ea86 with EXIT=0 and tests/negative-control.log reads '3 failed, 1 passed' with EXIT=1; deductions for the base arm being a git ls-tree presence inventory with no pytest summary, for done_when (3)'s all_debug host appearing in no log, and for the measurement running as job 1320896 plus recovery 1322107 rather than one job.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's existing seam checks at benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:1295-1310 and adds no name the repository rules forbid, with one deduction for the now-false docstring at benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:1870.
justifications.goal_fidelity: benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:1282-1287 attaches grid_moments[0], wall_moments[0] and sample_moments[0] from the one _moment_couplings call, so all six plasma rows of every target set come from one build_flux_blocks evaluation and _green_block supplies no solve row.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing build_flux_blocks and _moment_couplings kernel instead of adding one, and scripts/prototypes/diiid_single_kernel_coupling/render.py draws through nova.media.poloidal.draw_flux_contours, draw_nulls and draw_wall plus the checked save from scripts/prototypes/diiid_xpoint_offset/style.py.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 3b05ffb6..9ff3d99 lists 12 paths and each lies inside one of the node's five declared write paths, with the product change confined to the hunk at benchmarks/diiid_forward_gs_match.py:1279-1295.
